filing_office: Nebraska Secretary of State, Business Services
filing_fee_notes: Online base fee; in-office filing costs 110. Proof-of-publication filing is separately listed at 25 online or 30 in office.
registered_agent_rules: Maintain a Nebraska resident or business authorized to transact business in Nebraska. The agent's office must match the registered office; the formation form requires a Nebraska street address.
annual_report_due: April 1 in odd-numbered years; delinquent June 16.
plain_english_summary: File a Certificate of Organization and keep a registered agent. File a biennial report in odd-numbered years.
common_mistake: Do not treat the delinquency date as the report's due date.
notes: Scope: ordinary domestic LLC. Report fee is the confirmed paper amount; the online report fee was not independently confirmed. The report URL is the official filing gateway. Publication is null because the permitted pages confirmed a proof filing and its fee but did not establish the complete notice requirements. Processing time, expedite options, franchise or privilege tax treatment and operating-agreement mandate were not confirmed.
